rust_summary: A player's damaging melee hit decides whether it sweeps (`native_sweep_attack`).
doc_summary: A player's damaging melee hit is about to sweep or not, on the server and, from `Player.attack`'s client run, on the attacking client (which only asks; the server sweeps), after `native_critical_hit`: `native_sweep_attack(target, vanilla_sweep, sweeping, canceled)` may force the sweep (any held item, even a critical hit) or stop it; `canceled` skips the later mods and keeps `sweeping` as it is, so a mod doing its own sweep cancels with `sweeping` false. A critical hit that sweeps plays both sounds. Bundles need "hooks": @API:sweep_attack@.
